notes.name: case_narrative
notes.text: A 32-year-old male was admitted to the hospital on August 23, 2003, with several stab wounds. He had been found in an alley off Smith Street at 4 a.m. by the police. No weapon was discovered. He died at 6:30 p.m. on the same day. Autopsy revealed that the intrathoracic hemorrhage due to the stab wound of the lung could be considered fatal.
